name: Generic open-wheeler
description: Original generic open-wheel race car with mid-1990s proportions (short wheelbase, raised nose, small rims) and F2-class performance. Power and mass follow publicly quoted F2-class figures; everything else is an estimate. NOT measured data from any real car.

collisionRadius.note: car body = two circles of this radius

collisionOffset.note: circle centres this far ahead of / behind the CG

mass.note: car + driver; publicly quoted F2-class minimum weight

weightFront.note: fraction of static weight on the front axle

rollStiffnessFront.note: share of lateral load transfer taken by the front axle

loadTransferLag.note: time constant standing in for suspension compliance

bodyPitchGradient.note: steady body pitch per unit longitudinal accel (~0.7 deg per g)

bodyRollGradient.note: steady body roll per unit lateral accel (~0.85 deg per g)

suspensionDamping.note: damping ratio; < 1 gives a small overshoot

liftArea.note: Cl * frontal area (downforce, F2-class guess: less than a top-tier car)

draftLength.note: slipstream reaches this far behind a car

draftWidth.note: half-width of the slipstream right behind the car; it widens with distance

draftSpread.note: slipstream half-width growth per metre behind

draftMaxDragReduction.note: drag cut when tucked right in

draftMaxLiftLoss.note: downforce lost in dirty air when tucked right in

steerSpeedFalloff.note: speed at which available lock halves (keyboard-friendly; lock = max / (1 + (u/falloff)^2))

tireMuX.note: peak longitudinal friction at nominal load

tireMuY.note: peak lateral friction at nominal load

tireLoadSensitivity.note: mu drops by this fraction per +100% load over nominal

tireShapeC.note: Pacejka C. Higher = sharper drop after the peak

tireLowSpeed.note: slip denominators never go below this (numerical safety at standstill)

engineTorqueCurve.note: shape is a guess; scaled to ~460 kW (~620 hp) peak, the publicly quoted F2-class output

engineBrakeTorque.note: closed-throttle torque at the rev limit, scales to 0 at idle

gearRatios.note: top gear tall enough that drag, not the limiter, sets top speed (so slipstreaming helps)

finalDrive.note: geared so the limiter in top is just above the drag-limited top speed

reverseEngageSpeed.note: below this, holding brake selects reverse

ersPower.note: gameplay battery boost (Shift); F2-class cars have no ERS, this is a game feature

diffLocking.note: limited-slip: torque moved per rad/s of wheel speed difference

tcsSlip.note: combined slip / peak slip; 1 = at the tire peak

stabilityAssist.note: yaw damping towards the steered yaw rate; 0 = off

stabilityGripFraction.note: assist targets yaw rate up to this fraction of the tires' current lateral grip

stabilityFadeSpeed.note: assist fades in from 0 to full by this speed

assistLockRelease.note: how far TCS + stability assist back off in donut mode (full lock + full throttle, slow); 1 = fully off

assistReleaseSpeed.note: donut mode only below this speed; assists fully back by 2x this

tireShapeC.note: feel: gentle drop after the peak, slides are catchable

rollStiffnessFront.note: feel: a touch more understeer, rear stays planted
